measured_behavior: Cold reopen of the installed package with a cached verified shelf now reports Offline (server unreachable) before any connection attempt.

After the adult token was revoked with the server reachable, Connect reported denial; the identity-bound shelf stayed with the OS-possession disclosure, server actions were blocked, the installed archive was unchanged, and real Play started a detached child that survived wrapper exit.
The owned backend was then stopped after proving listener ownership and port closure. A cold reopen showed the offline shelf, a real failed Connect kept it, and real Play ran again.
In both modes the app disclosed that playtime reporting was unavailable, no playtime rows were added, and child and supervisor exit was verified through held kernel handles.

No Windows or macOS packaged journey, saves, update, rollback, uninstall, OS reboot, assistive technology or operator-host qualification.
Workstation Python and Node versions differ from the review baseline; workstation results are supporting only.
